question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

We **enjoyed very much** at the party.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. enjoyed ourselves very much .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is incorrect because the verb "enjoyed" needs a reflexive pronoun (ourselves) to make the statement grammatically correct.
 
• When describing enjoyment or actions that involve the subject themselves, reflexive pronouns (e.g., ourselves, himself, herself) are used.
 
• The correct phrase should be "enjoyed ourselves very much" instead of "enjoyed very much".

Correct sentence: *We enjoyed ourselves very much at the party.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Reflexive pronouns are used when the subject and the object of the verb are the same.
 
• Examples of reflexive pronouns include: myself, yourself, himself, herself, ourselves, themselves, etc.
 
• Other incorrect options:
 
 
• **Option 1:** "have enjoyed very much" – Incorrect as it misses the reflexive pronoun and doesn't fit in the past tense context.
 
• **Option 3:** "enjoyed at the party" – Incorrect as it omits the reflexive pronoun and is incomplete.
 
• **Option 4:** "were enjoyed" – Incorrect as "were enjoyed" is in the passive voice, which is not suitable here.
